failure.cause: The completed BASELINE-0025 validator accepted its final latest report only when the report manifest matched the current repository manifest, so a legitimate BASELINE-0026 successor manifest made the historical pointer appear stale.

remediation.rule: A BASELINE-0025 final report remains admissible only when it is a tracked passing final source/package report and either the current manifest matches or its own tracked companion manifest has checkpoint baseline-0025 and exact embedded SHA-256 identity.
remediation.focused_test: The current-manifest path, exact historical companion path, corrupted companion rejection, invalid latest rejection, and candidate-digest path are all exercised.
